attchmntText: Madhucon Projects Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 14, 2026, titled "Publication of Um-Audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026".
voiceSummary: Madhucon Projects Limited filed a notice with the Bombay Stock Exchange and the National Stock Exchange regarding the publication of its Un-Audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The results were published on 14th November 2026 in the Financial Express and Nava Telangana newspapers. Separately, AU Small Finance Limited issued an information notice under the SARFAESI Act 2002. The notice informed multiple borrowers and co-borrowers to remove movable assets from mortgaged properties scheduled for auction. Borrowers were required to remove assets within 15 days. Failure to comply would result in the transfer of assets to a rented location at the borrowers' cost. The notice listed specific loan account numbers, borrower names, and property descriptions across various districts including Warangal, Jangaon, Khammam, Prakasam, and Suryapet.

attchmntText: Madhucon Projects Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Madhucon Projects Limited approved un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The Board meeting was held on 13 November 2026. Standalone revenue from operations was 2,080.78 lakhs for the quarter and 4,859.44 lakhs for the half year. Standalone net profit was 1,029.93 lakhs for the quarter and 1,066.42 lakhs for the half year. Earnings per share were 1.40 for the quarter and 1.45 for the half year. Consolidated total income from operations was 7,843.45 lakhs for the quarter. Consolidated net loss was 2,083.66 lakhs for the quarter and 357.60 lakhs for the half year. Cash and cash equivalents stood at 14,452.73 lakhs as of 30 September 2026. The statutory auditors submitted a Limited Review Report.
